That seems to be the plan, which is why I’m sitting in this hearing room alongside many excellent local advocates. One state over in South Carolina, the legislature is currently debating a new law that would “increase the Palmetto State’s dependence on methane gas as a source of power generation, even as the burning of that harmful greenhouse gas accelerates the drowning of the South Carolina’s low-lying coast.” One state regulator has already resigned in disgust, saying the law would give utilities a ‘blank check.’
